correctness.rationale: Symbolic proof classifies one-sided constraints by two row permutations and right-handed constraints by one binary bit per column. It proves α is bijective exactly when the bits are constant on cycles of q^{-1}p, giving 2^{c} and a closed recurrence for the permutation cycle enumerator. Independent literal multiplication-table enumeration for r≤4 and parameter enumeration for r≤4 matched. No extrapolation or computational conjecture is needed; r=1 and opposite-band symmetry are included.

value.rationale: The same-permutation left/right condition is a natural orientation-invariant strengthening of one-sided semigroup transversals for noncommutative multiplication. The two-row family is the first nontrivial full rectangular band, yet the simultaneous share decreases exactly as (r+1)/2^r, revealing exponential scarcity invisible to existence theorems. The refined 2^{c(q^{-1}p)} cycle-colouring formula explains the structure, beyond a table or routine parameter substitution.
